title: Deep learning identifies etiology of non-traumatic intracranial hemorrhage on CT
summary: A deep-learning system on non-contrast CT reached AUCs of 0.986 for aneurysm, 0.952 for hypertensive hemorrhage, 0.950 for AVM and 0.749 for Moyamoya in the TT200 test set. A simulated clinician-aid study showed gains in sensitivity, specificity and accuracy for certain etiologies. The independent test sets are small for rare causes and the study is retrospective.
ai_technology: Deep-learning system for hemorrhage etiology classification on non-contrast CT
organization: Neurosurgery Department, Capital Medical University, Beijing, China; Beijing Tiantan Hospital, Capital Medical University, Beijing, China

evidence.tested: Two independent test datasets (TT200, SD98) and a simulated clinician-aid study.
evidence.unknown: Prospective clinical performance and effect on triage; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A deep learning model classified hemorrhage etiology from CT scans.
